title: feat(autocomplete): forward search params to the query API request
body:
**Summary**
[FX-3568]

This PR adds support to forward user provided search parameters for a query made in autocomplete. This is done via the new `searchParameters` base prop in widget as well as another `searchParameters` prop in each item in `indices`.

A fix has been made for isolated index widgets where instead of calling the helper.search immediately, it is deferred instead to allow the configure widgets to have time to mount and update the state (mainly for the react widget).

Docs PR has been linked to review the API changes easily.
